correctness.rationale: For every n, lambda and k, the decreasing geometric coefficients yield exact attained extrema including the full tail. Exponential scaling proves necessity of the lens. Balanced rounding of finite-jump controls approximates all points after arbitrary prefixes; Baire category gives simultaneous rational parameters and the proven uniform derivative bound extends to every real positive rate. The exact diameter is 1/2+2(e^{-lambda/2}-1/2)^2; the unique minimizer is 2 log 2. A standalone exact rational checker enumerated all 16,368 prefix/parameter cases, and checked construction and calibration. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: This solves a natural constrained information problem for classical Abel and Cesàro evaluation, rather than merely comparing convergent sequences: given the same empirical proportion, it computes the entire asymptotic feasible discounted range. The sharp universal half-width barrier 1/2 and unique optimal discount 2 log 2 provide an exact calibration law. Comeagre simultaneous realization rules out reducing the ambiguity by choosing a generic divergent binary stream, for every fixed discount. Both the conditional sharp profile and generic all-rate theorem give interpretable structural content beyond unconditional norm discrepancies.
